CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   C. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)

   D. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
